                                     ORDER NO. 4
                               REQUIRING CLARIFICATION
       In the State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH) Order No. 12 filed on
October 5, 2026, the SOAH Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) admitted several items as evidence
into the record of this proceeding.

       After further review of the filings made in this proceeding, the ALJ requires clarification
on the evidentiary record. Specifically, the ALJ is unable to locate in the record the following
items previously admitted as the Texas Industrial Energy Consumers’ (TIEC) exhibits:

       1.      TIEC exhibit 12: Governor Abbott Directive Letter to Thomas Gleeson (PUCT)
               and Pablo Vegas (ERCOT) on Audit of Data Centers, August 3, 2026;

       2.      TIEC exhibit 13: Data Center Ratepayer Protection Pledge – POTUS;

       3.      TIEC exhibit 14: FERC RD26-7-000 - Requiring NERC Reliability Standards for
               Computational Loads;

       4.      TIEC exhibit 15: Oklahoma Datacenter Ratepayer Protection Act – 2026;

       5.      TIEC exhibit 16: US House Ratepayer Protection Act – 2026 – amendment adopted
               by voice vote July 21 and Summary of Actions Page; and

       6.      TIEC exhibit 17: SWEPCO Tariff Book.

       By October 20, 2026, the parties must clarify where in the record the foregoing items are
located or otherwise file said items on the Commission’s Interchange.
 PUC Docket No. 58796                                         Order No. 4                    Page 2 of 2
SOAH Docket No. 473-26-07507

          Signed at Austin, Texas on the 15th day of October 2026.

                                                                 PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS




                                                                 ERIC YOON
                                                                 ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE
